page.layout: One scanned image of a closed book: the front board of a limp or boarded binding in pale vellum or leather with blind-tooled border lines. No printed page is visible. A paper label on the spine at the left edge carries handwriting and a shelf mark, which are not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan shows a bound book cover, not a printed page. The spine label carries handwritten and shelf-mark text (partly visible, e.g. "...5" and fragments of a handwritten title), which is excluded as handwriting and shelf mark. No printed text is present on this page.
